conclusion: The paper's 1.25 is reproduced by the FULL-PROPER-VOLUME weighting (1.25034) but NOT by the CREATED-volume weighting (1.28596) that h4_paper_text_audit.py's own docstring names as the justification, nor by the flat-volume weighting (1.24173). The agreement with the paper's text is therefore a property of one particular (natural but unstated) choice of weight. Claim weakened: '1.25 is reproducible by a natural weighting', not '1.25 is derived'.
